title: The Dynamics of Collapse and Recovery in Clustered Federated Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.28565v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Clustered federated learning (CFL) can suffer from cluster collapse. In particular, under unfavorable initialization, early client assignments concentrate heterogeneous groups on one cluster model, which is then trained toward a pooled compromise, while another model receives no updates. Since the current models determine client routing and routing determines subsequent model updates, we formulate clustered federated learning as control of an unknown dynamical system, with cluster models as the evolving state, client routing patterns as the control input, and routing interventions as state dependent controllers. In a two group linear model, we identify an initialization region in which greedy routing makes collapse self reinforcing. We then derive finite horizon error dynamics showing how routing interventions can reverse collapse by repeatedly training the starved model, primarily with updates from its compatible group. translated_title: 聚类联邦学习中崩溃与恢复的动力学
translated_abstract: 聚类联邦学习（CFL）可能会遭受聚类崩溃问题。特别地，在不利的初始化条件下，早期的客户端分配会将异构群体集中到同一个聚类模型上，该模型随后被训练为一个融合的折中方案，而另一个模型则接收不到任何更新。由于当前模型决定了客户端的路由，而路由又决定了后续的模型更新，我们将聚类联邦学习形式化为对一个未知动态系统的控制问题：聚类模型作为演化的状态，客户端路由模式作为控制输入，路由干预作为依赖于状态的控制器。在一个双组线性模型中，我们识别出一个初始化区域，在该区域内贪婪路由会使崩溃具有自我强化性。随后，我们推导出有限时域误差动力学，展示了路由干预如何通过反复训练“饥饿”模型（主要使用来自其相容组的更新）来逆转崩溃。受此启发……
tldr: 该论文将聚类联邦学习中的聚类崩溃形式化为未知动态系统的控制问题，识别出贪婪路由导致崩溃自我强化的初始化区域，并通过有限时域误差动力学证明路由干预可通过反复训练被忽视的模型来逆转崩溃。
